author: StewieFG
body:
Hey guys :)
Lately I have been making another map, in this time it's for the gamemode Capture The Wool.
This map's theme is an old broken buildings, abandoned place theme, hope you like it.




CHANGELOG:
Version 1: Rleased map
Version 1.1: Reduced the void place between all the islands and middle
Version 1.2: Added another island in middle of each team part






Special thanks to ScriptingLyfe / alexanderjoe10 for provoiding the server.

Name: Elbaz

Creators: ElectraXdroid

Gamemode: Nebula- Capture The Wool

Info:
* 2 Teams
*Blue Team- Lime and Orange wools
*Red Team- Yellow and Magenta wools
*30v30
*Iron

Images: http://imgur.com/a/24AFP

Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/1qt88vz4a2c10cw/lel.rar

YAML: Capture The Wool YAML Is farely hard to do, I'll be happy if one of the Map Developers will help me with the YAML.

Feedback is always appriciated :)
Hope you like! :D

replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
Really nice layout you have going on, I also like the naturalistic design and palette you went with.

I like the middle islands. They will provide some interesting gameplay because a team will have to hold the islands down from the enemy.

Some stuff that could be improved:
  • Shape of the iron - I like the iron on the map because it will probably benefit gameplay but the shape you have it in isn't that great. Maybe having it underground and having a small cave-ish area could be nice but its too high and stands out too much for my taste
  • Terraforming - I like how you terraformed the map at the wool rooms but the frontlines are really flat. You should work on improving it with minor height differences.
  • Wool rooms - I like the design you went with but the issue is that there is too much bedrock showing. You should add more detail on it and cover it with more blocks. After you do that it will look really nice with its shape.
  • Wool - There is too much wool in the chests. Full stacks of wool won't end well. Someone will take a stack and block spam back to their side to place it without needing a lot of skill. Maybe having 3 wools per chest slot (3x27) would IMO be better. Yes players could take more but they would have to save a bit more if they want to win.
  • Wool monument - The wool monument in spawn is bedrock but I think that you should again, like with the wool rooms, detail it a bit more. Its very plain and the texture of bedrock is a bit meh.
  • Biomes - You should use WE to set the map to one biome. You currently have multiple biomes on the map which changes grass and leaves colors. I think its something like //setbiome.
  • Sides - On the sides of the islands you used blocks like quartz and glowstone which IMO don't really fit in with the natural look of the map. You should change it to something that would work better with the map like planks, brown stained clay etc.
Its a really nice map and has a lot of potential. Gameplay shouldn't be that bad at the end but there are a couple aesthetic changes that should be done (mentioned above). Other than that really great job with the map!

EDIT: As for the people saying there is too much void, with the middle islands the void won't be that big of an issue. It will be interesting when players start making bridges and I think it will be good for the map if the void stays like this. Maybe after the test see how it will go and possibly reduce void later but currently I think the void is fine.
